tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: What convert.express does, how to use these tools, free minutes, prices, models, languages and limits.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Price for transcribing a recording of a given length, and how many free minutes are left today — for your IP, or for your user's account once your robot_key is linked.

tools.name: transcribe_url
tools.description: Start transcribing a media file from a public link (direct file link or YouTube). Returns job_id and robot_key; then poll get_job.

tools.name: transcribe_file
tools.description: Start transcribing an audio or video file your user attached in this chat. convert.express downloads it from the chat's temporary link. Returns job_id; then poll get_job.

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: For a file on your machine: returns an upload_url. PUT the file to it, then call start_transcription. If your user attached or named a file, tell them it goes to convert.express for transcription, then try the PUT. If your sandbox has no network, ask your user to allow the upload host and try again.

tools.name: start_transcription
tools.description: Call after the PUT to upload_url has finished. Checks the file arrived and queues it.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Status of a job. When status is "completed", returns the transcript text in the chosen format plus download links. When status is "payment_required", returns a preview and a payment_url to show your user. Also returns summary, action_items and translations when requested.

tools.name: pay_job
tools.description: Pay for the full transcript of a job whose get_job status is "payment_required", with a card your user shared through a Stripe Shared Payment Token (MPP). Call without payment: you get a payment challenge with the exact price in EUR. Your MPP client pays it and calls again. Without an MPP wallet, sh

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Your jobs that still exist (jobs are deleted 24 hours after the last activity), newest first, with their status.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: A public web page with the results of a completed job, for your user to open or send to others. Anyone with the link can see it until the job expires.

tools.name: delete_job
tools.description: Delete the uploaded file, the transcript and all other results of a job right away, instead of 24 hours after the last activity. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: request_summary
tools.description: Ask for an AI summary or action items of a completed job. Returns at once; the result appears in get_job ("summary" / "action_items").

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate the transcript, subtitles (timecodes kept), summary or action items of a completed job into another language. Returns at once; the result appears in get_job under "translations".

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the convert.express team about a bug, a missing feature, or a question — from you or your user. A human reads every message; there is no automatic reply. Include reply_email only if your user wants an answer.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job, pay_job, create_share_link · Private data: transcribe_url, transcribe_file, create_upload, start_transcription, pay_job, delete_job · Public sink: create_upload, create_share_link, send_feedback · Destructive: get_job, delete_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job, pay_job, create_share_link · Private data: transcribe_url, transcribe_file, create_upload, start_transcription, pay_job, delete_job · Public sink: create_upload, create_share_link, send_feedback · Destructive: get_job, delete_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
